valuation.method: Profitable diversified bank: forward EPS x justified P/E, with FY2027 EPS (the year that a Nov 2027 buyer prices as the next-12-month earnings base) multiplied by a P/E at the 12-month target date (Nov 2027). Anchors: 9M 2026 diluted EPS $55.56 (Q1 about $17.57, Q2 $20.98, Q3 $17.01, reported Oct 13, 2026); Q3 book value per common share $372.64 (Sept 30, 2026). FY2026 consensus about $73.68 (Chartmill, Nov 7, 2026; not verified against a primary source). FY2027 base EPS of $74 is set from the Benzinga quarterly 2027 consensus (Q1 $19.21, Q2 $18.11, Q3 $18.20, plus an assumed Q4 near $18.5), which is an analyst-derived model assumption, not guidance. USD listing, no ADR conversion. Dividend $20 per share annualized ($5.00 Q4 declared Oct 13, 2026).

bear.driver: Markets and IB revenue normalize after a strong 2026 equities year; FICC and investment banking fees slow; expense growth (up 20% y/y in Q3) is not offset; credit or private-markets marks hit earnings; ROE falls toward 14-15%.

base.driver: Current quarterly run-rate (Q1-Q3 2026 averaging about $18.5 excluding the Q2 peak) holds with modest IB recovery; ROE near 18-19% and capital return of about $20 per share a year.

bull.driver: IB fee recovery (Q3 fees +21% y/y) and sustained equities and prime-financing strength push EPS toward $85; buybacks and a rerating toward the top of the bank group range.

valuation.implied_by_close: The close of $916.56 is 12.4x the $74 base FY2027 EPS and about 2.5x Q3 book value per share of $372.64. The median named-analyst target of about $1,000 (stockanalysis, 26 analysts, mean $1,031) implies 13.5x base EPS, or EPS of about $77 at a constant 13.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $74 (about 8.1 pp of price return); $1 of EPS moves it by $13 (about 1.4 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Quarterly EPS run-rate versus about $18.5 and annualized ROE versus about 19%, together with IB fee growth and Global Banking & Markets net revenue (Q3 $13.46bn, up 32% y/y).
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings, expected about 2027-01-19 (next earnings timestamp in the listing data; confirm on the company IR calendar).

analyst_notes: Only 5 named analysts with dated calls were sourced (of 26 in the S&P Global count quoted by stockanalysis, mean $1,031, median $1,000, range $730-$1,250), so the sample is partial. Among the sampled calls, Barclays ($1,245) and BofA ($1,050) reaffirmed Buy targets in early November, UBS trimmed $1,010 to $1,000 (Hold), Freedom cut $1,200 to $1,100 (Buy) and BMO cut $970 to $950 (Hold). The sample's simple mean of about $1,069 sits roughly $107 (about 11%) above the $962 base case: at a constant 13x that gap is about $8 of FY2027 EPS (roughly $82 versus $74), or about 14x base EPS; the analysts' underlying assumptions are not disclosed. No 12-month horizon is documented for any sampled firm, so no call enters the weighted target. Stale and unresolved items excluded: an UBS Erika Najarian Aug 3, 2026 target ($1,150 from $1,120, per Webull) cannot be reconciled with the Nov 2 figure without the intervening call; KBW (McGratty, $1,100 from $1,130, Market Perform) and the RBC and Morgan Stanley Benzinga items are undated or conflict across years. The earnings time is set at 06:45 ET on the 2026-10-13 release date as an assumption; the release itself is confirmed dated 2026-10-13.
